description_en: Call the ListIoTCloudConnectorBackhaulRoute operation to query backhaul routes for a cloud connector instance after it is attached to a VPC
description_zh: 调用ListIoTCoudConnectorBackhaulRoute接口查询当前云连接器实例绑定VPC后的回程路由
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc list-iot-coud-connector-backhaul-route --iot-cloud-connector-id iotcc-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListIoTCoudConnectorBackhaulRoute

parameters.help_en:
The token to retrieve the next page of results.

For the first query, leave this parameter empty.

For subsequent queries, set this parameter to the NextToken value from the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the cloud connector instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html operation to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

schema.description_en: The number of entries in the list

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned per page
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数

NextToken.description_en:
The token that indicates whether more results are available. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no more results are available.

If NextToken has a value, use it as the starting token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

Description.description_en: The description of the route entry

DestinationCidrBlock.description_en: The destination CIDR block of the route entry

NextHopId.description_en: The ID of the next hop instance

NextHopType.description_en: The type of the next hop. Set this parameter to NetworkInterface to specify an elastic network interface (ENI) as the next hop
NextHopType.description_zh: 下一跳类型。取值： NetworkInterface，表示下一跳类型为弹性网卡

Status.description_en:
The publishing status of the route entry in the cloud connector. Valid values:

Published: The route is published.

Publishing: The route is being published.

Unpublished: The route is unpublished.

Unpublishing: The route is being unpublished.

Init: The route is not published.

Deleting: The route is being deleted
Status.description_zh:
路由条目在云连接器中的发布状态。取值：

Published：已发布。

Publishing：发布中。

Unpublished：已解除发布。

Unpublishing：解除发布中。

Init：未发布。

Deleting：删除中

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries in the list
